in_marathi.name: Kautilya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kautilya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kautilya is a name of Sanskrit origin that signifies intelligence and wisdom. This name is derived from the ancient Sanskrit word ‘Kautilya’, which means ‘skilled in wisdom’ or ‘intelligent counselor’. In Hindu mythology, Kautilya is most famously known as the chief advisor of ancient Indian emperor Chandragupta Maurya. Kautilya’s advice helped Chandragupta establish and expand his empire, and he is credited with writing the ancient Indian political treatise, ‘The Arthashastra’.
